projects.name: Guessing Game (existing project)
projects.milestones: V1 fundamentals Oct 28–Nov 4 → V2 OOP Nov 6–13 → V3 persistence Dec 2–6 → V4 collections scoreboard Dec 8–15 → V5 tests/docs/portfolio audit Jun 2–5
projects.publishRule: Publish after stable gameplay, a clear README, clean run instructions and tests or a test checklist.
projects.continuityRule: Keep the same folder and codebase. Each version upgrades the previous one; never recreate it for each topic.

versions.feature: Refactor repeated logic into methods; difficulty, limited attempts, hints, replay, input validation where appropriate.
versions.completionCheck: Play 5 rounds; test win/loss/replay, invalid input and edge cases.

versions.feature: Move state and behaviour into suitable classes while preserving gameplay; do not force inheritance or interfaces without a reason.
versions.completionCheck: Game still works; fields are encapsulated; explain each class and its responsibility.

versions.feature: Save/load high scores in a documented text format; handle missing, empty and malformed files.
versions.completionCheck: Scores survive restart; file errors are handled; existing game features still work.

versions.feature: Add a leaderboard with a justified collection and sorting; keep player data and game logic readable.
versions.completionCheck: Test empty board, tied scores, repeated players and ordering.

versions.feature: Add/verify README, clean commits, tests or a precise manual test checklist.
versions.completionCheck: Fresh reader can run it; known limitations and test results are documented.

projects.name: Banking and Account Management System
projects.milestones: V1 OOP console → V2 exceptions/validation Dec 1 and review Dec 16 → V3 persistence Dec 7 → optional concurrency lab Feb 14–16 → portfolio review Jun 2
projects.publishRule: Publish after operations, edge cases, persistence and limitations are documented and tested.
projects.continuityRule: One continuing codebase. The concurrency work is an educational lab, not production-grade financial software.

versions.feature: Implement account model, deposit, withdrawal, transfer, menu and validation.
versions.completionCheck: Balances remain correct; invalid amounts and insufficient funds are rejected.

versions.feature: Use clear errors/custom exceptions for invalid operations; review class responsibility and duplicate code.
versions.completionCheck: Test negative amounts, missing accounts, insufficient funds and malformed input.

versions.learnFirst: File I/O and documented data format
versions.returnWhen: Dec 7, 2026; revisit after Guessing Game persistence
versions.feature: Save/load accounts or transactions without losing the existing OOP design.
versions.completionCheck: Data survives restart; empty/malformed files are handled.

versions.feature: Use a small shared-account simulation to demonstrate a race condition and a synchronized fix. This is an educational extension, not production banking software.
versions.completionCheck: Repeat a controlled test and explain the observed issue and limitation.

projects.name: Smart Library Management System
projects.milestones: V1 OOP/borrow-return/member rules → V2 policy validation → V3 SQL schema Feb 20–21 → V4 frontend extension Apr 1–3
projects.publishRule: Publish after borrow/return rules, role-based limits/fines and sample scenarios work and are documented.
projects.continuityRule: Preserve the same domain model when adding SQL and the frontend. Do not rebuild from scratch.

versions.feature: Model Book, BookCopy, Member, Loan and FinePolicy; define teacher/student/pass-holder borrowing and fine rules.
versions.completionCheck: Test normal borrow/return, unavailable copy, overdue return and member-specific rules.

versions.returnWhen: Return during the V1 milestone and code review
versions.feature: Make borrowing limits, due dates and fine policies explicit and testable.
versions.completionCheck: Rules are not scattered randomly; tests cover each member type and boundary.

versions.learnFirst: SQL, keys, constraints, ER diagrams, normalization
versions.feature: Extend the same library domain to a relational schema for books, copies, members, loans and fines.
versions.completionCheck: Keys and constraints prevent invalid relationships; sample queries work.

projects.name: Inventory Management System
projects.milestones: V1 schema → V2 JDBC CRUD Feb 26 and Mar 4–6 → V3 transactions/reports Mar 8–13 → optional frontend extension Apr 1–3
projects.publishRule: Publish after schema, setup instructions, CRUD, transaction cases and sample reports are verified.
projects.continuityRule: Every milestone modifies the same schema/codebase. Record migration or setup changes.

versions.learnFirst: SQL basics, ER design, keys and constraints
versions.feature: Design products, categories and stock movements with sensible constraints.
versions.completionCheck: Sample inserts/updates/reports work; invalid data is rejected.

versions.feature: Connect Java CRUD to the existing schema using prepared statements and safe resource handling.
versions.completionCheck: Create/read/update/delete work from a clean start; no string-concatenated SQL.

versions.feature: Add transaction-safe stock changes and useful reports; refine the schema rather than replacing it.
versions.completionCheck: Test rollback/error paths, stock boundaries and report totals.

projects.name: Task Management REST API
projects.milestones: V1 Spring Boot CRUD Apr 5–16 → V2 tests/docs/integration Apr 17–28 → V3 security/config May 7–13 → V4 deployment/CI May 14–18
projects.publishRule: Publish stable tested milestones. Tag a release only after clean setup, API examples and test results are verified.
projects.continuityRule: Continue the same repository across April and May. Exam buffers pause work; they do not reset the project.

versions.learnFirst: HTTP, REST, JSON, Maven, Spring Boot
versions.feature: Build task CRUD with controller/service/repository responsibilities and SQL persistence.
versions.completionCheck: Endpoints behave correctly; validation and status codes are sensible; API can be run from documented instructions.

versions.feature: Add service and integration tests, edge-case handling, API documentation and a frontend integration checkpoint.
versions.completionCheck: Tests cover success/failure cases; README includes verified request examples.

versions.feature: Improve configuration, validation, error handling and basic security only after the API works. Never commit secrets.
versions.completionCheck: Configuration is documented; errors are predictable; no secrets are in the repository.

versions.feature: Deploy if a genuinely free suitable host is available; add a basic test/build workflow.
versions.completionCheck: Deployment and CI instructions are reproducible; clearly document any hosting limitations.

projects.name: Semester Planner Android App (Java, flagship)
projects.milestones: V1 requirements May 19 → V2 native app shell/timetable/tasks May 20–22 → V3 attendance/calendar May 23–24 → V4 local persistence/tests/README May 25–26 → portfolio review Jun 2–5
projects.publishRule: Treat as flagship only if the core Android workflow works, data survives restart, and implemented features are distinguished from future ideas. Reminders/widgets are optional later work.
projects.continuityRule: One native Android Java codebase from requirements through demo. Do not start a fresh app for each feature.

versions.learnFirst: Requirements, Java classes, mobile UI planning
versions.feature: Define semester, timetable, weekly lecture view, tasks and attendance. Treat reminders/widgets as later enhancements after the core MVP works.
versions.completionCheck: Screen flow and rules are documented, including holidays excluded from attendance percentage.

versions.version: V2: native app shell and workflows
versions.learnFirst: Android Activities/Views, Java model classes, navigation
versions.feature: Create a compiling Android Java app, weekly timetable navigation, and basic task/timetable CRUD.
versions.completionCheck: App launches; main screens navigate correctly; core CRUD works with sample data.

versions.learnFirst: Date selection, local data, attendance rules
versions.feature: Add attendance marking, holiday-aware percentage calculation, and calendar-to-week navigation.
versions.completionCheck: Test holidays, empty weeks and date selection; calculation rules are documented.

versions.feature: Persist timetable/tasks/attendance locally, test app restart and edge cases, and document setup/demo. Keep reminders/widgets as future milestones unless tested.
versions.completionCheck: App launches cleanly; data survives restart; README separates implemented features from future work.

projects.name: Frontend extension for Library / Inventory
projects.milestones: Build a small responsive UI for one existing domain; use mock data clearly labelled if backend integration is not yet ready.
projects.publishRule: Publish as a subfolder or extension of the existing project; avoid presenting a mock frontend as a fully integrated system.
projects.continuityRule: This is an extension milestone, not a seventh unrelated portfolio project.

versions.feature: Build a small responsive interface for an existing library or inventory workflow; keep it as an extension, not a disposable new project.
versions.completionCheck: Forms validate input; UI states and sample data work; document what is mocked.
